question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Now I need the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
-- That's the average of these totals: 864, 720, 960, 1240

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
        EXCEPT
        SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        current_id,
        cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_tree
    WHERE current_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM leaf_items
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM root_totals;
